name: @red-cup-engineering/uniform-resource-name-rendering-service
description: Transforms admitted RFC 8141 Uniform Resource Name parts {nid, nss, rComponent, qComponent, fComponent} into the canonical URN string that denotes them, or a typed refusal naming the exact ABNF rule a part breaks. Use when a system holds URN parts as structured data and needs the one wire string RFC 8141 says represents them, without re-deriving the '?+'/'?='/'#' delimiter placement by hand at every call site.
